relationships.evidence_quote: Suppression of TLR4 was observed in the cells cultured with nociceptin within a larger range of concentrations (0.1–100 nM) (Figure 8B).

relationships.subject: nociceptin
relationships.evidence_quote: Cell surface TLR2 was attenuated by the highest concentration of nociceptin, compared to controls (p < 0.05 Figure 8A).

relationships.subject: LPS
relationships.evidence_quote: LTA and LPS prevented PMA’s upregulating effects on ppNOC mRNA and nociceptin protein (both p < 0.05).

relationships.subject: PMA
relationships.evidence_quote: PMA upregulated ppNOC mRNA, intracellular nociceptin, and cell membrane NOP proteins (all p < 0.05).

key_findings: In THP-1 monocytes, nociceptin dose-dependently suppresses TLR2, TLR4, TLR7 and TLR9 proteins.
TLR2/TLR4 agonists block PMA-induced prepronociceptin and nociceptin upregulation, indicating reciprocal antagonism.
